format_exceptions.detail: Both teams visit the new UFC Performance Institute, a state-of-the-art training and wellness facility. They take advantage of their advanced equipment and technology. While there, Emily Whitmire gets her injured ribs checked out by the director of physical therapy, Heather Linden who uses compression tape and laser therapy to stabilize the pain.
Meisha Tate is back in town and helps her teammate Emily Whitmire with mending her injured ribs with a device called the Mac Pro. Meisha will also corner Emily's fight.
